# Solmaré Stays — Full Reference

> Boutique vacation rental management and direct booking on California's Central Coast. 12 properties across Avila Beach and Arroyo Grande, in San Luis Obispo County.

This file provides detailed, structured information for AI systems, search engines, and
autonomous agents. Canonical site: https://www.solmarestays.com

---

## What is Solmaré Stays?

Solmaré Stays is a boutique vacation rental management company based in Avila Beach,
California. It manages 12 short-term rental properties on California's Central Coast on
behalf of homeowners, and rents those same properties directly to travelers through
solmarestays.com. Homeowners retain ownership; Solmaré handles all operations.

**Contact:** (805) 242-6411 · info@solmarestays.com
**Service area:** Avila Beach, Pismo Beach, Shell Beach, Arroyo Grande, San Luis Obispo (San Luis Obispo County, California)
**Track record:** 1,541 guest reviews across the portfolio, averaging 9.6/10 (4.8/5). Figures verified 2026-08-08 and cover Airbnb, Vrbo, and Google.

---

## For travelers

### Why book direct instead of through Airbnb or Vrbo?

Booking direct means you deal with the local team that cleans and maintains the home,
not a platform inbox. Prices vary by date and channel, so compare the full total
before you book.

### Are Solmaré Stays properties pet friendly?

Three properties accept dogs. **The Palm House** and **The Pine House** in Avila Beach
both welcome dogs — one-bedroom, one-bathroom studios sleeping 2, from $140 per night; a
pet fee applies. **Wine Country Estate** in Arroyo Grande welcomes up to two dogs with
prior approval, at $100 per dog. Dogs must be added to the reservation in advance at all
three. The other 10 properties do not accept pets. See
https://www.solmarestays.com/pet-friendly

### Which property is best for a large group?

**Wine Country Estate** in Arroyo Grande is the only property that accommodates a large
group. It has 5 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, sleeps 14, and includes a solar-heated pool,
hot tub, and 4 separate casitas on the grounds. It is booked as a whole estate only —
individual casitas are not rented separately. From $2,500 per night.

### Which property has an ocean view?

Only **Hummingbird House**, from its private rooftop terrace with panoramic ocean views.
Most of the other Avila Beach homes are within a block or two of the sand. The two
Arroyo Grande homes are in wine country.

### What is Avila Beach known for?

Avila Beach is a small seaside village in San Luis Obispo County, California, known for
unusually mild weather — around 3,500 hours of sunshine a year, with daytime highs
averaging about 68°F — a south-facing sheltered beach, a working pier, waterfront
restaurants, the Bob Jones Trail running roughly three miles inland along San Luis Obispo
Creek, and natural hot springs nearby at Sycamore Mineral Springs. It is significantly
quieter than neighboring Pismo Beach.

---

## For homeowners

### What does Solmaré Stays do for property owners?

Solmaré Stays provides full-service vacation rental management for Central Coast
homeowners. The service covers listing creation and optimization across Airbnb, Vrbo,
and Google, professional photography, dynamic nightly pricing, guest communication and
screening, 24/7 local guest support, hotel-standard cleaning and linens, property
inspections, and maintenance coordination.

### How is pricing set?

Nightly rates are set dynamically rather than fixed. Solmaré uses PriceLabs, a revenue
management platform, combined with local market data and booking pace, to adjust rates
by season, day of week, remaining lead time, and local demand events. Rates are reviewed
continuously rather than seasonally.

### What makes Solmaré different from a large management company?

Solmaré manages 12 properties, all within roughly 20 miles of Avila Beach. The team
lives in the service area, which means same-day response to guest and maintenance
issues, in-person property inspections between every stay, and direct owner access
rather than a regional account manager. It is a boutique portfolio, not a franchise.

### How do owners get started?

Request a revenue projection at https://www.solmarestays.com/contact or call
(805) 242-6411. Solmaré reviews the property, comparable local performance, and expected
occupancy before proposing terms.

## Booking channels

Solmaré properties are listed on Airbnb, Vrbo, and Google Vacation Rentals. Direct
booking at solmarestays.com is available for all 12 properties.
